voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: In May twenty twenty, the Lancet published what was billed as the largest hydroxychloroquine study of the pandemic.
The data came from one company. A firm called Surgisphere.
Its own LinkedIn page listed six employees.
Thirteen days after publication, the study was fully retracted.
Two of the world's most trusted medical journals. Thirteen days. Nobody thought they'd need to check.
